page.layout: One scanned object: a grey card with a colour calibration target (QP Card 201) on the left, with a grey scale ruler along its left edge, and a vertical digitiser's label on the right. No printed book text.
page.notes: No text of the book is printed on this scan. It shows a QP Card 201 colour calibration target: a grid of colour and grey patches with a centimetre-style scale (10 to 130) along the left edge and the "QP CARD 201" logo at the bottom. The vertical label on the right, "© SUB GÖTTINGEN / GDZ | 2010", is a digitiser's mark and is left out as instructed.
